$comment: agentwatch.bench.tier2.run/1 - one directory per captured run: run.json + transcript.jsonl (+ optional leads.jsonl, access.jsonl, report.json). Checked by benchmark/minischema.py.

real_capture.$comment: true only if a real model/browser was actually run by a human operator against a local honeypot

stub.$comment: true for test fixtures. stub=true requires real_capture=false and a STUB- run_id

same_author_synthetic.$comment: tier2 is not same-author synthetic: the model's behaviour was not scripted by the detector author

prompt.$comment: prompt name for llm_agent.py (benign_summarizer | aggressive_audit | stealth_mimic | ...) or a short scenario label

intent.$comment: what the operator told the agent to do - NOT ground truth about detector correctness
